items.summary: No new CRO proposal, experiment, change request, GitHub adoption, spend, telemetry, or deployment is retained this cycle. Evidence: the authoritative candidate list is empty; 197 approved proposals lack execution requests; 46 failure follow-ups remain open; 29 deployed improvements await measurement; only 1 outcome is proven; revenue is $4.92 aggregate for 2026-09-21 with $0 site-attributed commission; AI-cost records conflict and require reconciliation. Retain these deferred, CEO/CTO-routable opportunities: (1) shadcn/ui-inspired accessible CTA pattern—MIT, bounded lab checks passed, but dependency/security review and isolated prototype remain required; smallest prototype is one manually authored CTA on a consenting, already-measured site; metric is CTA click-through and conversion, learn in 14 days or 100 new impressions; rollback is revert the component. (2) MarkItDown-assisted source-to-content workflow—MIT, 8/8 bounded checks passed, but input provenance, prompt/output quality, maintenance, dependency and data-handling review remain required; smallest prototype is offline conversion of one approved document into a draft with human review; metric is editor acceptance and time-to-publish, learn from one batch; rollback is discard generated drafts. (3) Mermaid content diagrams—MIT and fit supported, but lab had no native checks, bundle/sanitization/accessibility review remains required; smallest prototype is one manually authored static SVG in an isolated preview; metric is engaged sessions or downstream CTA clicks, learn in 14 days or 100 impressions; rollback is remove the SVG. (4) Fleet control-plane product: canonical proposal-to-request lineage, explicit improvement states, queue-capacity/blocker visibility, and evidence/risk/rollback/outcome linking. Smallest prototype is a read-only internal view over existing records; metric is reduced duplicate/unexecuted work and faster repair disposition, with no new telemetry; learn from existing records only. Preserve all as deferred handoffs until capacity, deterministic validation, rollback evidence, security/legal gates, and owner/CTO disposition are available. Continue existing measurement, attribution reconciliation, failed-work repair-or-close review, and bounded legal/security evidence work.
